m.e: Look, lucky breaks don't just fall from the sky.

m.t: , es gracioso cuando alguien lo toca y se le caen los pantalones.
m.e: You know, it's funny when someone's playing it and their pants fall down.

m.e: If I lose power, then my pants fall down.

m.t: Los bebés se caen a menudo.
m.e: Babies often fall down.

m.t: No dejaré que este lugar caiga en caos.
m.e: I will not let this place sink into chaos.

m.t: Ahora, la estación de Berlín... hasta que caiga.
m.e: Now, Berlin Station... till it falls.

m.e: Make sure your brother doesn't fall in the lake.

m.e: This is just to protect me in case I fall down.

m.e: He saved my life when I fell in the lake.

m.e: When I fell through I was scared, but I also, finally, understood.

m.t: Pero no, yo no caí en esa mierda.
m.e: But uh-uh, I didn't fall for that shit.

m.e: Still telling people I died in the war?

m.e: After all this time, you're coming with.

m.e: Even in butt for if you're in jail.

m.e: I'm gonna make a deal with you, kid, because I like you.

m.e: I think I liked you better when you kept your thoughts to yourself.

m.e: Well, you've got good taste in books, so you're all right with me.

m.t: Caes donde caes... y terminé con un auténtico ganador.
m.e: You land where you land... and I wound up with a real winner.

m.t: Parece que le caes bien a todos.
m.e: Everybody seems to really fucking like you.

m.e: If you go off a cliff, don't you die?

m.t: No estás a gran altura del suelo, así que si te caes, no es gran problema.
m.e: You're not that high off the ground, so if you fall, no biggie.

m.e: And I promise you, the only person who's gonna go down outta this is gonna be me.

m.e: The Temiken system will fall to our enemies within the week.

m.e: She'll plummet to the ground and die.

m.e: Well, actually they've spoken to each other on the phone, and they hit it off well.

m.e: And the other one gets me by the legs and down I go.

m.e: Or you just... you just don't like me?

m.e: And the welfare of an entire race now fell to her.

m.t: Por si acaso se caía la otra.
m.e: In case the other fell off.

m.e: We can shout from the rooftops, no one will listen to us.

m.t: Esos son los vientos de un cambio por venir.
m.e: That's the winds of change a'blowin'.

m.e: High winds cover up the rest.
